name: American Pipit
desc: American Pipit (Anthus rubescens): hunts or scavenges other animals. Recorded 8 times near the park in GBIF.
about: The American pipit, formerly known as the buff-bellied pipit, is a small songbird native to North America. It was first described by Marmaduke Tunstall in his 1771 Ornithologia Britannica.
